name: Geely Emgrand
summary: The Geely Emgrand (Chinese: 吉利帝豪; pinyin: Jílì Dìháo), originally the Emgrand EC7, is a car produced by Chinese automaker Geely Auto. After the discontinuation of the Emgrand brand, the EC7 was renamed to the Geely Emgrand in 2014.
